problem_type: A bounded model-facing projection drops entries without accounting for them
symptom: When a send-time selection exceeds the transient model budget, a partial handle list could look complete; the model could also be pointed at live domain reads that do not reconstruct which handles were selected in that message.
direct_cause: The projection owner used LIVE_READ_TOOLS and a no-read longest-prefix fallback, so budget pressure could remove only some kinds or leave a partial prefix. No model-visible tool read the immutable snapshot attached to the consumed message.
class_root: A bounded projection lacked one recoverable snapshot boundary: it could omit handles without a single all-or-nothing ledger and a pageable read of the same send-time snapshot.
affected_population: Any message-scoped selection whose compact projection exceeds 6000 characters
Mixed document, canvas, timeline, reference and future handle kinds
Any desktop Agent turn that tries to recover omitted handles after the UI selection changes
entry_points: Desktop lane model-facing read_selection registration and execution

external_sources.purpose: Opaque cursor, server page size, nextCursor completion and invalid cursor behavior
Agent-oriented tool boundaries, high-signal results, pagination/filtering, actionable errors and evaluation
Local run context is available to tools but is not automatically sent to the model
Reference read tool offset/limit continuation and truncation guidance

invariants: Projection either lists every handle at one detail rung or lists zero handles; omitted output always has total, listed, omitted, per-kind counts, the read_selection verb and a fixed note.
total = listed + omitted and listed handles preserve snapshot order.
read_selection reads the same immutable snapshot object consumed for the current message, preserves order, and returns total, bounded rows and nextCursor only when more rows remain.
Cursor is opaque, bound to snapshot identity and kind filter, and invalid or cross-message cursors fail closed without reading live state.
Every bounded read page stays within the shared 6000-character transient budget.

door_reduction.why_not: The two existing projection caller doors remain separate because one injects the live provider message and the other builds a compaction summary. The new read door remains in laneDesktopTools because it is the only execution boundary with the consumed message context. The declaration, capability registry and type/profile doors are separate registration boundaries that must remain explicit so model exposure cannot drift from the desktop-only contract.

generality_proof: Every bounded send-time projection still passes through projectAgentContextSnapshot/formatAgentContextSnapshot, while every desktop recovery call passes through readAgentContextSnapshotPage against the consumed message context. The shared owner has no kind-specific live-read branch or prefix fallback, so existing producers and future handle kinds receive the same all-or-nothing accounting and page contract.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own the single all-or-nothing projection, budget ladder and omitted ledger.
Own opaque cursor validation, kind filtering, page sizing and the compact handle row shape.
Expose read_selection only in the desktop internal lane and bind it to the consumed message context.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses formatAgentContextSnapshot for every provider-bound desktop message.
Uses the same projection owner for compaction summaries.
Reads input.context().contextSnapshot and calls readAgentContextSnapshotPage; no renderer or live domain read is substituted.
The verb declaration is internal-only, so MCP has no snapshot read tool.
This is the existing document.read transport scope alias; registry order preserves its dispatcher resolution and it is not the model-facing snapshot verb.
This is #1283 live canvas rendering with a separate owner and contract; this change does not alter it.

recurrence.reason: Any future handle producer or larger mixed selection can exceed the projection budget; any desktop turn can have its live UI selection changed after send, so only a message-bound page read preserves semantics.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs formatAgentContextSnapshot: two existing projection caller doors
node scripts/door-map.mjs readAgentContextSnapshotPage: laneDesktopTools is the single read execution door
rg AgentContextSnapshot electron src: producers remain residentContextSnapshot, directorShotFocus and agentReferenceContext; no new producer is added
model-facing registry and MCP projection checked: read_selection is internal-only and cannot appear on MCP

prevention.invariant: The shared owner either lists all handles or zero handles with a stable per-kind omitted ledger; readAgentContextSnapshotPage returns bounded pages from the same snapshot and rejects invalid or cross-snapshot cursors.
prevention.failure_mode: Budget overflow emits no handle rows; missing snapshots and invalid cursors throw machine-readable failures with a model-executable next step.
prevention.strategy: Delete the LIVE_READ_TOOLS and no-read prefix branches, keep one compact row encoder, bind cursor lifetime to the current snapshot object, and expose the new verb only through the desktop internal profile.

legacy_paths.rationale: The LIVE_READ_TOOLS class-to-tool table, its per-kind live-read ledger and the no-read longest-prefix fallback are deleted in the same change. The only recovery path is read_selection paging the send-time snapshot.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal projection contract; no third-party runtime controls it.

migration: No snapshot format or stored data changes. Existing transcripts re-project with the new ledger; read_selection cursor state is process-local and never persisted, so old messages either have no current context snapshot and fail visibly or are sent again with a fresh snapshot.
residual_risks: The separate live look_at_canvas result still has its own node-list budget and is outside this change.
Real-model read_selection adoption and answer accuracy remain unverified until the coordinator runs the paid sample.
Cursor identity is process-local by design; a restarted lane must start from the first page.
